title: 'Win against India damaged us a lot': Yousuf explains Pakistan cricket's decline
content: Pakistan had never beaten India in a World Cup before that match in 2021. Babar Azam scored an unbeaten 68, while Mohammad Rizwan made 79 not out as Pakistan chased down 152 without losing a wicket. The win was celebrated as a historic moment for Pakistan cricket. However, Yousuf believes the victory also changed the mindset of the players and played a role in the team's decline in the years that followed.

title: Tech CEO added to FBI's Most Wanted Fraudsters list after fleeing from United States
content: Tech CEO Bernhard Fritsch has achieved infamy by landing a spot on the FBI's Most Wanted Fraudsters list after his conviction for investment fraud. Sentenced to fifteen years in prison and required to make restitution, he managed to evade authorities post-arrest in Mexico by escaping to Germany. The FBI is now urgently seeking tips that could lead to his recapture and subsequent conviction.

title: Jeff Bezos' ex-wife sets new record with donations to historically Black colleges
content: MacKenzie Scott has now donated over one billion dollars to historically Black colleges. Her recent forty-two million dollar gift to Elizabeth City State University marked this milestone. Scott has provided significant funding to numerous institutions since 2020. These unrestricted donations empower universities to allocate funds as needed. Her extensive philanthropic efforts support various educational and community initiatives.

title: Ultra-rich pay $650,000 for Martha’s Vineyard 'beach keys'
content: Exclusive access to beaches on Martha's Vineyard is proving to be a hot commodity, with keys selling for exorbitant amounts—often in the hundreds of thousands. These keys offer private shorelines away from the crowded tourist spots, appealing to affluent buyers. The rising demand pushes prices higher, leaving locals and seasonal renters feeling alienated and resentful over their dwindling access to the island’s natural beauty.

title: Palantir-Backed Ukraine Defence Venture: Fedorov launches secretive startup
content: Former Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov is launching a new defense technology venture. Palantir CEO Alex Karp is serving as the startup's first lead investor. This initiative aims to commercialize Ukraine's battlefield innovations for allies. Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt also developed a low-cost drone for Ukraine. These efforts highlight Ukraine's growing defense technology sector.

title: The Yamuna is rising again: How prepared is Delhi for another flood?
content: Delhi is under the shadow of recurrent flooding threats as the Yamuna River inches closer to its danger threshold. The catastrophic floods from the previous year resulted in the displacement of thousands and interrupted vital public services. Fortunately, this year has seen reduced upstream water releases, offering a brief respite; however, the risk of heavy rainfall above could still ignite a serious crisis.

title: India eyes nuclear power in Andamans as China challenge grows near Malacca Strait
content: Scientists are currently evaluating potential locations for Small Modular Reactors throughout the archipelago. This pivotal initiative is designed to bolster the islands' energy resilience and satisfy increasing energy demands. Additionally, it supports critical infrastructure developments, including the International Container Transhipment Terminal, while further enhancing India's strategic role in the eastern Indian Ocean and its oversight of vital shipping lanes.

title: 100% recycled glass foam supports added lanes on Arizona's I-17
content: In a groundbreaking interstate expansion project in Arizona, engineers harnessed recycled glass aggregate as a revolutionary structural fill. This eco-friendly innovation not only provided lightweight support for drainage culverts but also showcased impressive compressive strength. Utilizing foam glass from recycled bottles minimized the need for expensive culvert replacements and significantly cut down on construction delays, ultimately transforming waste into vital infrastructure enhancements.

title: After reconnection, Lake Erie wetland logged 3.44 million fish detections
content: A rejuvenated wetland at Lake Erie witnessed an influx of aquatic wildlife thanks to its reconnection. High-resolution sonar has captured a staggering 3.4 million fish movements entering and exiting this newly transformed habitat. This research reveals valuable insights into how aquatic species engage with restored coastal ecosystems, as fish showcased varied activity throughout both day and night, influencing management strategies for restoring Great Lakes wetlands.

title: Builder promised 5,069 sq ft, delivered 3,900; RERA orders refund, Rs 98 lakh penalty
content: Telangana RERA condemned the use of such tactics by the builder, stating that the alleged conduct amounted to cheating, violated Section 3 of the RE(R&D) Act and made the builder liable for a penalty.

title: US war veteran's home threatened by Elon Musk's AI data centre in Tennessee
content: Residents in Memphis are grappling with the effects of a massive artificial intelligence data center that has recently opened its doors. The surge in energy consumption has led to soaring utility bills for local families, casting a shadow on community wellbeing. Amidst growing noise pollution and escalating living costs, citizens are voicing concerns about the sustainability of such rapid technological advancements and their impact on daily life.

title: Hulk Hogan's Florida mansion gets another $1m cut, now listed for $6.9m
content: Hulk Hogan’s Clearwater Beach mansion has received another $1 million price cut and is now listed for $6.9 million. The wrestler’s five-bedroom waterfront home was initially listed for $10.98 million after his death. Hogan bought the property for $3.33 million in 2012, while his neighbouring property was purchased for $1.6 million four years later.

title: Newlywed stabbed to death by sister-in-law over remark on jailed brother
content: A newlywed woman has been tragically murdered, allegedly at the hands of her sister-in-law after a violent argument. The accused is said to have stabbed the victim and hidden her remains in a water tank. This incident stemmed from an earlier quarrel related to the sister-in-law's brother. Following the incident, police utilized CCTV evidence and forensic fingerprints to arrest the suspect, highlighting the dark tensions surrounding the victim's recent marriage.

title: How discarded Christmas trees are being used to build dunes on a UK beach
content: Discarded Christmas trees are being used to strengthen the sand dunes at St Annes beach on England’s Fylde Coast. Since the project began in 2013, the trees have helped trap wind-blown sand and expand the dunes. The wider dunes act as a natural sea defence, helping protect nearby homes and businesses from coastal flooding while also creating habitat for specialised plants and wildlife.

title: Charles Leclerc's Ferrari wrecked in brutal Monza crash - Watch
content: At Monza, Charles Leclerc experienced a severe crash that halted the race with a red flag, disrupting Ferrari's home grand prix. Fortunately, he emerged from his wrecked car unscathed. After a restart led by George Russell, Kimi Antonelli impressively raced to victory from a lower starting position, while Lewis Hamilton secured sixth place for Ferrari, rounding off their efforts in the race.

title: IPO rush ahead: 11 companies line up to raise Rs 7,055 crore from investors
content: The primary market in India is gearing up for an exciting week ahead, with eleven main-board IPOs lined up to collectively raise more than seven thousand crore rupees. These IPOs span various sectors, showcasing a vibrant market landscape. Most will launch on Tuesday and Wednesday, highlighting the robust corporate belief and strong liquidity present in the market.

title: Bullion markets this week: US inflation, crude and Middle East tensions to set the tone
content: This week sees potential volatility in gold and silver prices, primarily driven by upcoming US inflation figures and interest rate speculation. The influence of crude oil fluctuations and geopolitical developments in the Middle East also play a significant role. Additionally, ongoing purchases by central banks, notably in China, bolster gold values. Key economic reports from Germany, China, and the Eurozone will further guide market sentiment.

title: Jaguar Land Rover may cut 4,000 jobs as it targets £1.7bn in savings
content: Jaguar Land Rover may cut up to 4,000 jobs as the Tata-owned carmaker targets £1.7bn in savings over two years and seeks to lower its break-even point to 300,000 vehicles. The move comes a year after a major cyberattack disrupted production and could put further pressure on Andy Burnham’s pledge to reindustrialise Britain.

title: US envoys in Kyiv, but Russian strikes persist across Ukraine: 8 killed, 69 injured
content: Russia ramped up its aerial bombardment across Ukraine, resulting in eight fatalities and sixty-nine injuries. Ukrainian air defense successfully intercepted the majority of the one hundred eight drones launched overnight. Meanwhile, US diplomats arrived in Kyiv for discussions following a meeting with President Vladimir Putin in Moscow. Although temporary pauses in attacks were noted over Moscow and Kyiv, broader hostilities persisted in the regions despite ongoing diplomatic negotiations.

title: Fire Island glass house gets $1.255m price cut but still seeks record $3.995m
content: Crest House, a four-bedroom glass estate in Fire Island’s Cherry Grove, has drawn more than 350 viewers since being listed for $5.25 million in July 2026. Despite the attention, the property has not found a buyer. Its price was first cut to $4.85 million and has now fallen to $3.995 million. The current asking price is still far above Cherry Grove’s record sale of $2.7 million.

title: Florida island bought for $14.5m in 2015 now asks $89m after major upgrades
content: Mark Pentecost has listed his stunning private island retreat for a staggering eighty-nine million dollars. Acquired eleven years ago for a mere fourteen point five million, this one hundred four-acre island boasts a private golf course and twenty-nine potential residential plots. As the founder of It Works!, Pentecost has skillfully developed this paradise into both a business and family haven, offering unparalleled fishing and coastal access near Boca Grande.

title: Honeytrap, Rs 1 cr demand: Cops probe UP officer’s 'blackmail' before suicide
content: A police officer died by suicide after alleged blackmail by a woman and her associates.  The woman, her father, and a lawyer were arrested and sent to judicial custody.  Investigators claim the woman used recorded conversations to extort money from men.  Police suspect the officer was a target of this alleged extortion network.  The investigation continues to establish the full sequence of events and financial transactions.

title: Less crew, more tech: How China’s next-gen Type 100 is changing the tank playbook
content: China's new Type 100 main battle tank is appearing in new footage.  This advanced vehicle features an unmanned turret and active protection systems.  It also incorporates hybrid-electric propulsion for reduced signatures.  The tank is designed for networked battlefield operations and deep assaults.  This new platform signals a significant shift in China's armored warfare approach.

title: Max Verstappen's Monza story: From fastest lap in F1 history to P5 start at 2026
content: In an explosive display of speed, Max Verstappen shattered two Formula 1 records at Monza in 2025. With an average of 264.682 km/h, he clocked the fastest qualifying lap in history, while the 2025 Italian Grand Prix itself marked a record for the quickest race ever. Despite this success, Verstappen's performance saw him qualifying fifth for the upcoming 2026 Italian Grand Prix.

title: Meet Bompelly Bhavani, whose 1,336 teaching videos crossed 57 crore views
content: Telangana government-school teacher Bompelly Bhavani is among the 48 recipients of the National Teachers’ Awards 2026. Her work at MPPS Girls Gandhari helped increase enrolment from around 40 to 130 students, while her 1,336 teaching videos crossed 57 crore views. From play-based learning and digital pedagogy to community outreach and coaching rural students, Bhavani’s journey reflects how teachers are expanding their role beyond classrooms. The article also profiles the other educators recognised nationally for transforming school education.

title: How Kentucky protected a vast elk landscape
content: Kentucky hunters faced uncertainty with temporary land access agreements. A new conservation partnership secured permanent public access to a large elk hunting area. This agreement provides 54,560 acres for public use in eastern Kentucky. The project involved state officials, conservation groups, and federal funding programs. This ensures continued hunting traditions and habitat restoration for future generations.

title: Women's rights pioneer Lisle Lester's ashes return home after 138 years
content: Lisle Lester, a journalist, publisher, actress and women’s-rights advocate from Fond du Lac, died penniless in New York in 1888 at age 50. Her cremated remains remained unclaimed for 138 years. After efforts by local women and the Fond du Lac Soroptimists, her remains have now returned home for burial.

title: New Zealand home values hit three-year low as buyers remain cautious
content: The housing market in New Zealand has experienced its most significant decline in over three years, driven by factors such as elevated interest rates and a shaky economy. Since early 2022, home values have continuously dropped, with the Reserve Bank predicting further falls before any signs of recovery. Experts suggest that a rebound in the market hinges on improvements in the labor sector.

title: Amazon-linked Boeing 767 crashes off Miami runway, huge smoke plume seen in video
content:
Miami airport: Boeing 767 overruns runway, huge black smoke plume seen

An Amazon-linked Boeing 767 cargo aircraft overran the runway after landing at Miami International Airport on Sunday, according to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). Video footage showed the aircraft positioned alongside a road after it went off the runway. A huge plume of black smoke can be seen rising high into the sky in the video. The aircraft “overran the runway after landing at Miami International Airport around 2 pm local time,” the FAA said in a statement to CNN. The Boeing 767-300 cargo aircraft had departed from Luis Munoz Marin International Airport in San Juan, Puerto Rico, the FAA said. More details awaited

End of Article
